pages.title: Hippidion
pages.text: The hippidion ($(o)Hippidion principale$()) is an extinct horse that lived in South America during the Pleistocene, disappearing around the end of the last ice age.$(br2)It was stockily built, with short, robust legs, and was the largest member of its genus.$(br2)Its skull had unusually long, slender nasal bones and a deep nasal notch, a feature that sets it apart from the true horses of the genus $(o)Equus$().
